name: Xayah
title: the Rebel

Q.name: Double Daggers
Q.description: Xayah throws two daggers, dealing 45/60/75/90/105 + 0.5×bonus AD physical damage each and leaving two Feathers. Targets hit after the first take (45/60/75/90/105 + 0.5×bonus AD) × 0.5 damage from each dagger.
Q.summary: Xayah throws two damaging daggers that also drop Feathers she can recall.

W.name: Deadly Plumage
W.description: Xayah creates a storm of blades for 4 seconds that grants her 35/40/45/50/55% Attack Speed and cause her Attacks to fire a secondary blade that deals 25% damage. When the secondary blade hits a champion, she grants herself 30% Move Speed for 1.5 seconds. If Rakan is nearby he will also gain the effects of this Ability, except he gains Move Speed when Xayah strikes a target.
W.summary: Xayah creates a storm of blades that increase her Attack Speed and damage while also granting her Move Speed if she attacks a champion.

E.name: Bladecaller
E.description: Xayah calls all Feathers back to her, dealing (50/65/80/95/110 + BADRatio×bonus AD) × (1 + (0.5×crit × (1×stat + -1))) physical damage each. If 3 or more Feathers hit an enemy, they are Rooted for 1.25 seconds.
E.summary: Xayah calls back all her dropped Feathers dealing damage and rooting enemies.

R.name: Featherstorm
R.description: Xayah leaps into the air becoming Untargetable and Ghosted for 1.5 seconds before raining down daggers that deal 200/300/400 + 1×bonus AD physical damage and leave behind a line of Feathers.
R.summary: Xayah leaps into the air becoming untargetable and throwing out a fan of daggers, dropping Feathers she can recall.

Passive.name: Clean Cuts
Passive.description: After using an ability, Xayah's next basic attacks will hit all targets along their path and leave a Feather.
Passive.summary: After using an ability, Xayah's next basic attacks will hit all targets along their path and leave a Feather.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Marksman who leaves feathers on the ground and recalls them with E. Wins fights by rooting enemies with E and dodging engage with R's untargetable.
strengths: E recall roots targets hit by 3+ feathers
R untargetable dodges engage and targeted abilities
weaknesses: Short range compared to some ADCs
Feathers must be set up before E roots
No dash; R is her only escape
profile.curveNote: Her root combo needs Q/W feathers plus E recall.

W.notes: Attack speed; attacks leave extra feathers.

profile.windowAgainst: R down and no feathers on the ground: engage her.
checks: Whether Jax E/blinds stop W's extra feathers (they come from attacks).
